decisions.statement: The count is the count the tracking day has.
The count is how many game tasks are undone at the end of that day.
A count stated as text is read as the number that count spells.
A count of zero is a count.
No tracking day is no reading rather than a count of zero.
A tracking day with no count is no reading rather than a count of zero.
Nothing here decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a count into a color.

definition: how many game tasks are waiting
